inference_unit: five donor-derived cell lines; cultures and wells nested within donor
primary_matching: Cell plus Experiment; include only blocks containing both VEM and CTRL
aggregation: mean normalized expression over wells within condition and culture, then equal mean across matched cultures within each donor; donors equally weighted
normalization: edgeR TMM over matched samples after condition-blind filter; normalized logCPM prior.count=0.5
primary_endpoint: signed rank disease reversal: mean drug-minus-control percentile rank of frozen human DOWN genes minus that of frozen UP genes; positive indicates opposing direction
rank_background: all retained original gene-symbol features; average ties; (rank-0.5)/N; no within-study outcome selection
mapping: org.Hs.eg.db exact SYMBOL to ENTREZID, retain one-to-one only; no alias rescue
primary_test: one-sided exhaustive sign-flip of five donor scores (32 patterns), equal-donor mean; H1 positive reversal; symmetric independent donor effects assumption, not randomized treatment permutation
selection_limit: VEM selected after inspecting LINCS exploratory ranks and cardiac resource availability; this is a planned external-context exploratory analysis, not prospective confirmatory validation
gene_analysis: limma-trend on ten donor-condition mean logCPM profiles with donor fixed effect and VEM contrast; residual df=4; BH over all retained genes; exploratory
pathway_analysis: camera on donor-condition logCPM, donor-adjusted, estimated residual intergene correlation; same five fixed Reactome sets, BH over eligible sets; exploratory
sensitivity: all samples from the same five donors, without culture matching; primary gene background retained and TMM recalculated
leave one donor out descriptive scores
leave one matched culture out descriptive scores
outlier_rule: no outcome-driven exclusions; retain samples passing prior count integrity checks; zero library or failed metadata gate halts analysis
scope: expression response in healthy-donor-derived cardiac cultures, not rescue of sepsis-exposed cells or functional cardiac safety
